map.乙醇、甲醇、氰化物、一氧化碳、硫化氢等: Ethanol, methanol, cyanide, carbon monoxide, hydrogen sulfide and so on
map.特征：樱桃红尸斑(CO)、褐色尸斑(亚硝酸盐)、苦杏仁味(氰化物): Features: cherry-red lividity (CO), brown lividity (nitrite), bitter almond smell (cyanide)
map.砷、汞、铅、铊等: Arsenic, mercury, lead, thallium and so on
map.特征：慢性中毒多见，砷-皮肤角化/色素沉着；铊-脱发；汞-口腔炎/震颤: Features: chronic poisoning is more common; arsenic causes skin keratinisation and pigmentation, thallium causes alopecia, mercury causes stomatitis and tremor
map.有机磷（敌敌畏、甲胺磷）、百草枯、氟乙酰胺、毒鼠强等: Organophosphates (dichlorvos, methamidophos), paraquat, fluoroacetamide, tetramine and so on
map.特征：有机磷-瞳孔缩小/肌颤/蒜臭味；百草枯-肺纤维化: Features: organophosphates cause miosis, muscle fasciculation and a garlic smell; paraquat causes pulmonary fibrosis
map.镇静催眠药（巴比妥、苯二氮卓）、阿片类、安非他明等: Sedative-hypnotics (barbiturates, benzodiazepines), opioids, amphetamines and so on
map.特征：巴比妥-皮肤水疱/针尖瞳孔；阿片类-瞳孔缩小/呼吸抑制: Features: barbiturates cause skin blisters and pinpoint pupils; opioids cause miosis and respiratory depression
map.植物毒素（乌头、钩吻、雷公藤）、动物毒素（蛇毒、蜂毒）: Plant toxins (aconite, gelsemium, tripterygium), animal toxins (snake venom, bee venom)
map.特征：乌头-心律失常；钩吻-呼吸抑制；蛇毒-局部肿胀/出血: Features: aconite causes arrhythmia, gelsemium causes respiratory depression, snake venom causes local swelling and bleeding

map.📚 深度解析：中毒（毒物谱）快速筛查: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Poisoning (Toxin Spectrum) Rapid Screening
map.不明死亡的中毒方向初筛: Initial Screening Direction for Unexplained Deaths
map.按症状+尸表征象+暴露史匹配毒物谱：一氧化碳（樱桃红尸斑、HbCO 升高）、氰化: Match the toxin spectrum by symptoms, post-mortem findings and exposure history: carbon monoxide (cherry-red lividity, elevated HbCO), cyanide (bitter almond smell, bright red blood, cherry-red venous blood), ethanol (alcohol smell, blood alcohol), organophosphates (pinpoint pupils, cholinergic effects) and so on, producing a testing priority order.
map.尸斑樱桃红 + 血中 HbCO>50% → 提示一氧化碳中毒，优先测血羧基血红蛋: Cherry-red lividity with blood HbCO above 50% indicates carbon monoxide poisoning, so carboxyhaemoglobin should be measured first; another case with a bitter almond smell, bright red blood and cherry-red venous blood indicates cyanide poisoning, so blood cyanide and thiocyanate should be tested first.
map.初筛阳性就能定毒物吗？: Can a positive screen identify the toxin?
map.不能。征象多为提示性，必须实验室确认（气相/液相色谱、质谱、特效酶法）；且多种毒: No. Findings are mostly indicative and must be confirmed in the laboratory (gas or liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, specific enzyme methods). Several toxins can also overlap in findings, so a full workup is needed.
map.症状重叠度高，暴露史（职业、服药、现场容器）能显著缩小毒物范围、确定化验靶标，避: Symptoms overlap heavily, so exposure history (occupation, medication, containers at the scene) can greatly narrow the toxin range and identify laboratory targets, avoiding blind screening and missed detections.
